entities.summary: Kiryat Bialik is a city in the Haifa District in Israel. The city was established on July 18, 1934, during the Fifth Aliyah. It is one of the five Krayot suburbs to the north of Haifa. In 2024 it had a population of 47,073. Kiryat Bialik is a city in West Asia, established around 1934. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
